comments.text: I would say no. This is an ability meant to be fair to all. Not affected by class abilities or feats at all.

paragraphs.text: Many items are far more difficult to find and have a much higher DC. You can search for them yourself, or recruit the help of others. You can assist another character. Spend your roll to grant them ad
